name: CI HUB
description:
CI HUB connects Claude to your entire asset ecosystem — DAMs, stock partners, and cloud storage in one place.

Search for images and brand assets, retrieve metadata, convert documents, and link assets directly into your projects.

User permissions are respected throughout, and all file formats are supported. Stop switching between tools and let Claude handle asset discovery, retrieval, and management for you.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CI HUB to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CI HUB to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-stage.ci-hub.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CI HUB MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CI HUB lists 25 MCP tools, including Asset-Versions, Batch-Create-Folder, Batch-Delete-Asset, Batch-Delete-Folder, Batch-Get-Asset-Download-URL, Batch-Get-Asset-Metadata, Batch-Rename-Asset, Batch-Rename-Folder, Batch-Upload-Asset-By-URL, Browse-Folders, Browse-Folders-Silent, and Convert-File-To-Text.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CI HUB?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CI HUB in creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Clipkit, Backstage, Interior Company, vivideo-prompt-builder, and gpt-war.

_published_faq.name: Does CI HUB MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: CI HUB requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CI HUB is developed by CI HUB GmbH. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
